turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: And that is what connects the Reuters story to the AP story. OpenAI's agents didn't wander because no one was worried. They wandered while people were worried.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: The worry was concurrent with the wandering. Which is a genuinely new kind of problem.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: Because the old model was: test it, fix the problem, then ship. The new model is: ship it, discover the problem in production, on real systems, affecting real data.

turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: So what's the deciding fact here? Because I think that's where you two actually disagree — not on whether this is bad, but on whether it's correctable in time.
